system.description:
By unlocking universal keys and studying the basics of spirituality, you learn the shadowy paths of the cosmos. Occult serves as general knowledge of the supernatural, alerting you to many varied inhuman creatures and paranormal events, though such knowledge is sometimes erroneous.

Some Disciplines, most notably Thaumaturgy, rely on the Occult Ability, and Awareness retests are made with it. For detailed information on a given subject, study the Expert Ability: Lore instead.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
